subject: SIG + privacy review: DPA / SCCs and HIPAA feasibility
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Legal <legal@acme.io>; Acme Cloud Security <security@acme.io>
Date: 2026-07-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: SIG + privacy pre-sales: DPA/SCCs & HIPAA feasibility

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Our procurement/legal team asked if you could fill out the SIG questionnaire for our standard security intake and clarify a few privacy items before we proceed to commercial terms:

- Completed SIG (we can take an Excel or PDF)
- Confirmation on whether Redwood will sign our DPA or provide an equivalent DPA; whether you support SCCs for EU data exports
- Any constraints or guidance on HIPAA/BAA — our healthcare customers require this and we need to know feasibility and any hosting constraints (VPC/on-prem only?).

Can you share a draft SIG and an estimated timeline? We’d like to get through this week if possible.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Chen
Head of Security Programs, Acme Cloud
liam.chen@acme.io

——
Attachment: acme_sig_request_20260730.docx (referenced)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-30T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG + privacy pre-sales: DPA/SCCs & HIPAA feasibility

Liam — thanks for the clear ask. I’m attaching our working SIG draft and looping in Monica (legal) and Markus (security) to confirm a few items. Quick notes up front:

- Attached: redwood_SIG_draft_20260730.xlsx (editable) — it has answers for the majority of SIG sections; open items are marked with **NEEDS_LEGAL** or **NEEDS_SEC**.
- DPA/SCCs: Redwood has a standard DPA and can execute via DocuSign. We also support SCCs. Monica will confirm the template and preferred flow.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads only on Private deployments (VPC or on-prem). We can provide a BAA for Private deployments; hosted/shared instances are not eligible. Markus will outline technical requirements and evidence.

Proposed timeline:
1) Today — share draft SIG and initial evidence pointers (SOC2 summary, policy extracts).
2) Mon/Tue — legal reviews/DocuSign DPA if required.
3) Week of Aug 9 — HIPAA feasibility call for technical onboarding if you want to pursue BAA.

I’ll follow up with the completed SIG once Monica/Markus confirm the flagged items.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

——
Attachment: redwood_SIG_draft_20260730.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme.io>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-31T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG + privacy pre-sales: DPA/SCCs & HIPAA feasibility

Rishi / team — I reviewed the draft and made a few edits to the DPA language we generally use with mid-market customers. Summary:

- DPA: We can sign Acme’s DPA with two clarifications: (1) subprocessors list is provided via our portal and will be appended by reference; (2) liability cap remains as negotiated in the contract (we can discuss commercial). I’ve queued a DocuSign envelope — link below.
- SCCs: We support SCCs. If you require EU standard contractual clauses for transfers, we will append the Commission’s SCCs and map data flows.
- Data retention / deletion: flagged a SIG answer where Acme asked for deletion SLA for customer data — our standard is 90 days for temp logs, 365 days for persistent application telemetry unless agreed otherwise.
- HIPAA/BAA: We can enter a BAA but only if Acme uses Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem). The BAA requires a short security questionnaire and proof of Private provisioning. Expect 2–4 weeks for legal + security review once Acme signs DPA/BAA.

Action items:
- Rishi: finalize SIG answers where I left comments (3 items).
- Liam: if OK, sign DPA in DocuSign (https://na1.docusign.net/sea/send?envelopeId=0f1a2b3c4d5e).

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

——
Attachment: (DocuSign envelope queued)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme.io>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:47:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG + privacy pre-sales: DPA/SCCs & HIPAA feasibility

Team / Liam — I completed the security evidence items called out in the SIG. See notes below and attached stubs.

- SOC2: We have a current SOC 2 Type II report covering Security and Availability (summary attached: SOC2_summary.pdf). Full report available via secure portal: https://redwood-secure-portal.example.com/reports/soc2/ACME-2026 (portal access request required).
- Logging & retention: See log-retention-policy.pdf (we retain application logs for 90 days by default; security logs retained 365 days).
- Access controls: MFA for all staff, SSO enforced for production consoles, RBAC for team separation (documented in SIG section 4).
- Encryption: Data at rest and in transit using AES-256/TLS1.3; KMS integration supported for Private deployments.
- HIPAA feasibility: Confirming Monica’s note — HIPAA customers must be on Private deployments. Technical checklist:
  * Dedicated VPC or air-gapped on-prem install
  * Customer-managed KMS (recommended)
  * Network isolation and explicit support hours for onboarding
  * Security assessment (standard questionnaire + evidence)

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf; log-retention-policy.pdf

If Acme wants to move forward on HIPAA, propose a 45-minute technical call with our infra lead and your engineering/security owners to map the deployment plan.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Product Security, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T08:15:00Z
Subject: Final SIG answers + next steps for DPA / HIPAA call

Liam — attaching the consolidated SIG (redwood_SIG_answers_v1.xlsx) with Monica/Markus’ edits incorporated. Highlights and next steps:

- SIG: Completed and marked where evidence is linked. Please review the highlighted cells — 2 legal clarifications remain (data deletion window and subprocessors confirmation).
- SOC2 evidence: summary attached; full report via secure portal (link above). If you need the full report uploaded to your vendor portal, let me know and we’ll request access.
- DPA / SCCs: Monica has queued the DocuSign envelope here: https://na1.docusign.net/sea/send?envelopeId=0f1a2b3c4d5e — please sign and we’ll countersign. We can append SCCs and map them to the data flows in the SIG.
- HIPAA / BAA: Confirming that Redwood will execute a BAA for Private deployments only. If you want to pursue HIPAA, can we schedule a 45-min technical sync the week of Aug 9? Proposed attendees: Acme engineering/security + Redwood infra/security.

Please reply with (A) confirmation to sign the DPA, and (B) a few time slots for the HIPAA technical call if you want to proceed.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
